title.en: Send a DoH query with curl

why.en: Cloudflare's public DoH endpoint also speaks a JSON flavour, which is easy to read. It is still an HTTPS request on port 443.
why.hinglish: Cloudflare ka public DoH endpoint ek JSON flavour bhi samajhta hai, jo padhna aasaan hai. Ye phir bhi port 443 pe HTTPS request hai.

expect.en: A JSON document with Status 0 and an Answer list holding example.com A records and their TTL. Addresses and TTLs vary.
expect.hinglish: Status 0 aur example.com ke A records aur unke TTL wali Answer list ke saath ek JSON document. Addresses aur TTLs alag ho sakte hain.

title.en: See the HTTP side of DoH

why.en: Looking at the response headers shows the content type and cache lifetime that RFC 8484 talks about.
why.hinglish: Response headers dekhne se content type aur cache lifetime dikhta hai jiski RFC 8484 baat karta hai.

expect.en: HTTP 200 with 'content-type: application/dns-message' and a cache-control: max-age value close to the record's TTL. Exact headers vary by provider.
expect.hinglish: 'content-type: application/dns-message' aur record ke TTL ke kareeb cache-control: max-age value ke saath HTTP 200. Exact headers provider ke hisaab se alag hote hain.

why.en: The same question over UDP 53 is what an ISP can read. Capture it in Wireshark with the filter below and compare.
why.hinglish: UDP 53 pe wahi sawal wo hai jo ISP padh sakta hai. Neeche wale filter se Wireshark mein capture karke compare karo.

expect.en: The same A records, but this query travels in plain text over UDP 53. Addresses vary.
expect.hinglish: Wahi A records, lekin ye query UDP 53 pe plain text mein jaati hai. Addresses alag ho sakte hain.

title.en: Find the DoH traffic in the capture

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark and filter for the TLS handshake and the plain DNS contrast.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur TLS handshake aur plain DNS contrast filter karo.

expect.en: The Client Hello shows SNI dns.example and ALPN h2 in clear; the DoH query itself is encrypted, while the plain DNS packets from the comparison step are readable.
expect.hinglish: Client Hello clear mein SNI dns.example aur ALPN h2 dikhata hai; DoH query khud encrypted hai, jabki comparison step ke plain DNS packets padhe ja sakte hain.
